basic_details.job_title: MGCU JRF/Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.details: JRF/Project Fellow: M.Sc. Physics/Chemistry with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA with the interest in research in the area of Experimental Condensed Matter Physics/Material Science/Physical Chemistry/Inorganic Chemistry. Knowledge of nanomaterial synthesis, thin film deposition, Ion Implantation, familiar with SRIM/TRIM software etc. will be preferred.

salary_details.details: JRF/Project Fellow (without NET/GATE): Rs. 14000/- p.m. for first two years, Rs.16000/-p.m. for the third year. JRF/Project Fellow (NET/GATE qualified): Rs. 25000/- p.m. for first two years, Rs.28000/- p.m. for the third year.

selection_process: Shortlisting based on merit and project requirement Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MGCU JRF/Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGCU JRF/Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 23 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the JRF/Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry with at least 55% marks or an equivalent CGPA, along with a research interest in the specified areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for a JRF/Project Fellow at MGCU?
faq.answer: The salary varies based on qualification. For non-NET/GATE candidates, it's Rs. 14,000-16,000/- p.m. For NET/GATE qualified candidates, it's Rs. 25,000-28,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the provided email address, along with a CV and self-attested copies of relevant documents.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the JRF/Project Fellow position announced in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF/Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the preferred qualifications or knowledge for this role?
faq.answer: Knowledge of nanomaterial synthesis, thin film deposition, Ion Implantation, and familiarity with SRIM/TRIM software are preferred.
